cell_v_max.source: A123 (3.6 V charge + 0.05 V measurement tolerance, assumed)

temp_max_c.source: A123 operating max 55 degC + 5 degC margin (assumed)

limits.wording: UL 1974-style triage. This is a screening step, not UL certification or a safety approval.

references.wang2011: J. Wang et al., "Cycle-life model for graphite-LiFePO4 cells", J. Power Sources 196 (2011) 3942-3948. Capacity loss = B * exp((-31700 + 370.3 * C_rate) / (R T)) * Ah^0.55 for LFP; source of the activation energy (31.7 kJ/mol) and of the C-rate term (370.3 J/mol per C).
references.he2011: W. He, N. Williard, M. Osterman, M. Pecht, "Prognostics of lithium-ion batteries based on Dempster-Shafer theory and the Bayesian Monte Carlo method", J. Power Sources 196 (2011) 10314-10321. Source of the double-exponential capacity-fade form Q = a e^(b k) + c e^(d k).
references.naumann2018: M. Naumann et al., "Analysis and modeling of calendar aging of a commercial LiFePO4/graphite cell", J. Energy Storage 17 (2018) 153-169. Calendar capacity loss grows roughly with the square root of time; used for the form of the calendar term only.
references.naumann2020: M. Naumann et al., "Analysis and modeling of cycle aging of a commercial LiFePO4/graphite cell", J. Power Sources 451 (2020) 227666. Shows cycle-depth dependence beyond simple charge- throughput equivalence; used qualitatively to set k_dod >= 1.
references.severson2019: K. Severson et al., Nature Energy 4 (2019) 383-391. Defines the reference conditions of the ML model (30 degC chamber, 100 % DoD between 2.0 and 3.6 V, 4C discharge).

discount_rate.note: real discount rate for a small storage project

stationary_pack_usd_per_kwh.source: BloombergNEF 2025 Lithium-Ion Battery Price Survey (press release, Dec 2025): stationary storage pack average $70/kWh; overall average $108/kWh

installed_system_usd_per_kwh.source: BNEF Battery Storage System Cost Survey, US average turnkey system $236/kWh, as reported by energy-storage.news
installed_system_usd_per_kwh.note: older survey than the pack price; turnkey system, not comparable with the pack figure

value_per_kwh_delivered.note: USD per kWh discharged (avoided grid purchase / arbitrage spread). Site- and tariff-specific; replace with the user's tariff.

max_service_years.note: cap on second-life duration regardless of SOH

nickel.source: LME nickel cash settlement 23 Oct 2026 (Westmetall LME table)

lithium_carbonate.source: Battery-grade lithium carbonate, ex-works China, 30 Sep 2026 (Benchmark Mineral Intelligence, as cited in secondary reporting); GFEX futures 12 Oct 2026 were ~104,740 CNY/t (~15,650 USD/t)
